args.title: Triage issue #4410: update config.ts
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: int function in src/config.ts uses Number.parseInt(raw, 10) to parse integer configuration variables like TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES and RESET_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES without validating whether the entire string was parsed successfully, meaning strings like "12h" or "1h" are parsed as 12 and 1 respectively rather than triggering validation errors or parsing failures.

args.title: Triage issue #4423: update index.ts
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: pickLocale parses the Accept-Language header by splitting on commas and taking the first matching language, completely ignoring q-weights (such as `en;q=0.3, fr-FR;q=0.9`), causing preferences like French with higher quality values to be ignored in favor of lower-weighted earlier languages.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

pickLocale parses the Accept-Language header by splitting on commas and taking the first matching language, completely ignoring q-weights (such as `en;q=0.3, fr-FR;q=0.9`), causing preferences like French with higher quality values to be ignored in favor of lower-weighted earlier languages.
